minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  September 29, 2020

The Successor Agency of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, September 29, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

MAYOR PRO TEM APPOINTMENT. It was moved by Council Member Franklin,
and seconded by Council Member Padilla that the City Council does hereby appoint
Council Member Morales as Mayor Pro Tem for Closed Session. The motion was
carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin;
Noes:  None; and
Absent:  Mayor Butts.

Mayor Pro Tem/Successor Agency Chairman Pro Tem Morales called the City
Council/Successor Agency into Closed Session at the hour of 1:00 p.m.
The Acting City Clerk/Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Council Members/Successor Agency Members Dotson,
  Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Pro Tem/Successor Agency
  Chairman Pro Tem Morales; and
  Absent:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman Butts.
City/Successor Agency officials and personnel present for closed session were as
follows:

  Aisha Thompson  Acting City Clerk/Secretary
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor Pro
Tem/Successor Agency Chairman Pro Tem Morales inquired if there were any persons
present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency on any Closed Session
Item.

There was no response.

Mayor Pro Tem/Successor Agency Chairman Pro Tem Morales recessed the City
Council/Successor Agency at the hour of 1:01 p.m., for Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1 &
CSA-1, and CS-2.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance
Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:02 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/ Finance
Authority Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary
announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Finance  Authority  Chairman/  Parking
  Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers Authority Chairman
  Butts,  Council  Members/Successor  Agency
  Members/Housing  Authority  Members/  Finance
  Authority Members/ Parking Authority Members/ Joint
  Powers Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and
  Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

  1
 September 29, 2020

  City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority/Finance Authority/ Parking Authority / Joint
  Powers Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority, Finance
  Authority, Parking Authority, Joint Powers Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Parking Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons
  present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any item on
  the Agendas.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4 resident, spoke concerning Agenda Items Nos. 1, CSA-2, and H-
  1, Warrant Register, and 3, Amendment Three to Agreement No. 19-077 for the Welfare-
  to-Work Vocational, Intermediary and Direct Services.

  Bill (Last Name Unknown), spoke concerning Agenda Item Nos. 5, Amendment No. 1 to
  Agreement No. 17-541 with County Hills Animal Clinic, and DR-5, Resolution to amend
  the Policies and Procedures Manual for the Inglewood COVID-19 Debit Card Program.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member
  /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by
  Council Member /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Morales that
  the demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  September 25, 2020, in the amount of $2,605,222.65, are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 132.6  CLOSED SESSION – PENDING LITIGATION; CITY OF INGLEWOOD V.
  CENTINGLEWOOD, LLC, ET AL.; LASC CASE NO. BC711437. Closed session –
  Confidential – City Council and Successor Agency Board Members Conference with
  Legal Counsel Regarding Pending Litigation Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54956.9(d)(1); City of Inglewood v. Centinglewood, LLC, et al. (APN 4024-038-042);
  LASC Case No. BC711437.

  It was moved by Council Member/Successor Agency Member Franklin, and seconded by
  Council Member/ Successor Agency Member Padilla that the City Council does hereby
  approve settlement and request to use Tax Exempt Bond in the amount of $50,000. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and
  Franklin;
  Noes: None; and
  Abstain: Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman Butts.

 219  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TREASURER – MONTHLY TREASURER’S REPORT.
  Staff report dated September 29, 2020, was presented submitting the Monthly Treasurer’s
  Report for the Month ending May 31, 2020.

  Successor Agency Chairman Butts ordered the report received and filed.

  2
 September 29, 2020

  There being no further business to be presented, Successor Agency Chairman Butts
  declared the meeting adjourned at the hour of 2:39 p.m.

  Approved this ______day of ___________, 2021.
